⏳ Truck Claim Process

If the customer wants to transfer the truck from one RMN to another RMN, guide them through the truck claim process.

Steps to Claim the Truck
  1. Open Boss App and click on your profile
  2. Click on "KYC"
  3. Click on 'Upload' next to the truck number
  4. Upload KYC documents to start claim process
TAT for each KYC Process
Add truck number10 mins
Truck owner KYC document verification15 mins
Dues to be cleared for assets in old RMNVaries
Truck claim initiated12 hrs
Truck removal from OLD RMN12 hrs
Once truck removed, Fastag & diesel get deactivatedTAT to be shared accordingly
Post approval13 hours
How to Add New Truck
  1. Open Boss App and click on your profile
  2. Click on "Your Trucks"
  3. Click on add new truck on the top right corner
  4. Add your truck number and click on the add button below
  5. Your truck will be added
Note: The truck will show under "My Trucks" but the customer can't purchase any assets until the claim process is complete. KYC documents (Truck RC + Truck owner KYC) are required, and there should be no assets remaining in the old owner's RMN.

🏦 Retail / Non-BB Tag Closure

For a Non-BB IDFC tag deactivation/removal request — ask for the retail documents, raise a ticket to IR, and IR escalates to the category team to get the tag closed.

Documents Required for Retail Tag Closure
  1. Pan / DL / Voter ID
  2. Truck RC
  3. Passbook or cheque with IFSC code, account number and customer name (account name should match Truck RC & KYC)
  4. Tag trash image, to confirm it's the same barcode activated in NHAI by a different vendor (optional)
  5. Consent letter, including: Reason for the closure · Account holder name · Old customer retail ID · Today's date · Customer sign · VRN (truck number)

🗑️ Fastag Order Cancellation

If the customer or CRO is calling for a Fastag order cancellation, guide them with the steps below.

Before suggesting cancellation from the app, check:
  1. App should be on the latest version
  2. Request should be in the "Confirmation Pending" or "Request" tab
  3. If the request is in the Approved tab — ask the CRO to fill the Google Form; Ops will check NHAI status and cancel only if it hasn't been activated
Note: The app only allows cancellation when the request is in the Confirmation or Request tab — for both issuance and replacement (IDFC & Axis).

⚠️ Fastag Not Working

🔎 Step 1: What is the situation?

🧭 Basic Pre-Check — do these 4 checks in order, then pick the situation below
1
Check the truck is Active

Search in L1 Support. The truck number and its status appear at the right end of the search bar.

✅ Status shows Active → go to Check 2.
❌ Truck is not active (e.g. removed) → choose Tag Not Visible below.
2
Check the Fastag is Active and visible in L1

Open the FASTag section in L1 and confirm the tag card is listed for this truck (bar code, tag id and status are shown on the card).

✅ Tag card is visible and active → go to Check 3.
❌ Tag card is missing or deactivated → choose Tag Not Visible below.
3
Check the balance is above the minimum threshold

On the same tag card, read the Current Balance (circled) and compare it with the minimum balance for the bank. Minimums: IDFC ₹99 · Axis ₹200 / 500 / 550 · Livquik ₹200.

✅ Balance is above the minimum → go to Check 4.
❌ Balance is negative or below the minimum → choose Balance Negative (Hotlisted) below and ask the customer to recharge.
4
Check the Fastag status on the NHAI portal

Search the truck number on the NHAI / ICICI Online Pass portal and read the result row. Look at the Hot List, Low Balance and Black List status columns.

✅ Statuses show No → tag is clear at the portal; continue with Fastag Status is Active below.
❌ Portal shows hotlisted / blacklisted → choose Balance Positive but Showing Hotlist or Fastag Status is Blacklisted below.
✔ All 4 checks done? Now select the customer's situation below.

❓ Frequently Asked (Objection Handling)
Will I be charged INR 9/- for every transaction?

Yes, the charge will be levied on every transaction.

Why were the charges not being deducted earlier?
🗣️ Say to Customer

Sir/Ma'am, these are the commission charges that BlackBuck has to pay to third-party apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, etc.). Earlier we used to pay the charges to them ourselves, but now we've started debiting your account. We request that you please use the BlackBuck App to avoid these charges.

Sir/Ma'am, yeh commission charges hain jo BlackBuck ko third-party apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, etc.) ko dene padte hain. Pehle hum yeh charges khud pay karte the, lekin ab hum aapke account se debit karna shuru kar diya hai. Hum request karenge ki in charges se bachne ke liye BlackBuck App use karein.
Why is this happening only on my truck, and not on my friend's truck?
🗣️ Say to Customer

Sir/Ma'am, this charge is system-generated and happens automatically. If you recharge outside the BlackBuck app directly, the charge is deducted automatically from your FASTag.

Sir/Ma'am, yeh charge system-generated hai aur automatically hota hai. Agar aap BlackBuck app ke bahar se seedha recharge karte hain, to charge automatically aapke FASTag se deduct ho jata hai.
I've been using Google Pay/PhonePe/Paytm for a long time and I'm more comfortable with it.
🗣️ Say to Customer

Sir/Ma'am, I can understand your concern — recharging your FASTag through the BlackBuck app is the simplest method and your amount will be secure. Guide the customer for Auto Recharge.

Sir/Ma'am, main aapki concern samajh sakta/sakti hoon — BlackBuck app se FASTag recharge karna sabse simple tareeka hai aur aapka amount secure rahega. Customer ko Auto Recharge ke liye guide karein.
While trying to add money to my wallet, I'm only able to add ₹2,000 and not more than that.

Educate on the alternate options: use a different UPI mode if one is facing an issue, or use another payment mode, or recharge in parts. If the customer still faces the issue after trying all alternates, take the details, log a ticket, and assure the customer it will be resolved on priority.

Why is the other company not charging, while we are charging?
🗣️ Say to Customer

Sir/Ma'am, these are the commission charges that BlackBuck has to pay to third-party apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, etc.). We don't have any information regarding other companies. We request that you please use the BlackBuck App to avoid these charges.

Sir/Ma'am, yeh commission charges hain jo BlackBuck ko third-party apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, etc.) ko dene padte hain. Hume doosri companies ke baare mein koi jaankari nahi hai. Hum request karenge ki in charges se bachne ke liye BlackBuck App use karein.

🔒 Boss App Access Denied

FO's account is blocked due to the use of multiple credit/debit cards, and he's unable to log in to the Boss App.

🗣️ Say to Customer

Dear Customer, we understand that your account is currently blocked, and we regret the inconvenience caused.

To help us investigate and resolve the issue, we request you to send an email to support@blackbuck.com with the following details:

  • Screenshot of the error message
  • Registered Mobile Number (RMN)
  • Brief description of the issue, if applicable

Once we receive the email, our Email Support Team will review the concern and respond within 24 hours. The issue will be investigated, and a resolution will be provided within 72 hours, subject to the nature of the issue.

Kindly send an email to Support@blackbuck.com with the error screenshot, and the email team will revert within 72 hours.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Why am I being charged a convenience fee?

The convenience fee of ₹3 is introduced to cover the cost of maintaining and enhancing the app services, ensuring a smooth and reliable experience for all users when recharging FASTag.

Is this fee mandatory?

Yes, the ₹3 convenience fee applies to all FASTag recharges made through the BlackBuck app. It helps us maintain the quality and efficiency of our services.

Are there any other ways to recharge FASTag without paying this fee?

No, the convenience fee is specifically for transactions made through the BlackBuck app. While we strive to offer the most convenient and efficient service through our app.

What if I'm not happy with this fee?

We understand your concerns, and we're committed to offering the best service possible. The fee helps us maintain and improve the app, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience for all users. We appreciate your understanding and feedback.

How was the ₹3 fee determined?

The ₹3 fee was carefully determined after considering the costs associated with processing payments, maintaining app infrastructure, and providing 24/7 customer support. Our goal is to keep the fee minimal while ensuring a high-quality service.

Will the convenience fee change in the future?

Currently, the fee is set at ₹3. We continually review our pricing structure to ensure fairness and transparency. Any changes to the fee will be communicated to our users in advance.

Is the fee refundable if the transaction fails?

If your recharge transaction fails and no funds are deducted, the convenience fee will also not be charged. If funds are deducted but the recharge fails, we will process a refund for both the recharge amount and the convenience fee.

Does the fee apply to all transactions or just FASTag recharges?

The ₹3 convenience fee currently applies specifically to FASTag recharges made through the BlackBuck app. Other transactions may have different fee structures, which will be clearly communicated at the time of the transaction.

Can I pay the convenience fee using the same payment method as the recharge?

Yes, the convenience fee will be added to your total transaction amount and can be paid using the same payment method you use for the FASTag recharge.

How can I provide feedback about this fee?

We value your feedback and are always looking to improve our services. You can share your thoughts directly through the app's feedback section or contact our customer support team.

🔍 Check First

📶 Low Network

🗣️ Say to Customer

Sir, I can see the GPS is showing low network — this could mean the truck is in an area where the telecom network is weak (parking lot, jungle, international border areas, etc.), which is why it's showing low network.

Sir, mujhe dikh raha hai ki GPS low network dikha raha hai — iska matlab ho sakta hai ki truck kisi aise area mein hai jahan telecom network weak hai (parking lot, jungle, international border area, etc.), isliye low network dikh raha hai.

Ask if the FO is aware the truck might be at such a location.

Customer says Yes

Tell him once the truck leaves the low-network area, the GPS will start working. If it still doesn't work after that, ask him to call back.

Customer says No

No worries, we'll get it checked with our technician.

If a ticket is already raised for the same issue/truck — inform the FO it's visible on the Boss App; just confirm the date range and location if not already mentioned. If already mentioned, tell him the technician will visit on that date (name/number visible on Boss App once assigned).

If not raised yet — inform the FO that a ticket has been raised, and the concerned team will reach out within 24 hours of the truck-availability date he provides. Technician name/number will show on the Boss App once assigned.

🔌 Wire Disconnected

Politely check with the FO if the GPS wires might be disconnected, the truck is under maintenance, or there's a battery issue.

Truck is under maintenance

Inform the FO the issue is because the maintenance-shop technician/driver likely removed the battery or GPS. It'll start working once the truck is out of maintenance — if not, ask him to call back and we'll arrange a technician.

Not under maintenance / wants it fixed

No worries, we'll get it checked with our technician once the truck is available.

If already raised for the same issue/truck — inform the FO it's visible on the Boss App; confirm date range and location if not mentioned, or share the technician's visit date if already mentioned.

If not raised — inform the FO a ticket has been raised and the team will reach out within 24 hours of the truck-availability date.

🔄 Continuously Goes On/Off

FO reports the GPS works fine sometimes and not other times, automatically.

No worries, we'll get it checked with our technician. Ask for the date range and location where the FO wants it checked/repaired. Inform him a ticket has been raised and the concerned team will reach out within 24 hours of the truck-availability date.

💳 Not Working + Payment Due

FO asks if the GPS isn't working because payment is due.

Ask the FO to clear the GPS dues and guide him through the subscription renewal process.
In parallel, check the Boss Portal for a Low Network or Wire Disconnected status and follow those steps as well.

♻️ Number Already a Registered Boss Account

Process
  1. Ask the FO to clear any pending dues
  2. Deactivate the GPS on the old account
  3. FO adds & claims the truck on his new Boss account
  4. Ask the FO to add the amount for the duration he's already used the GPS (see calculation below)
  5. Once he pays the difference, he places a new order from the new Boss account and we activate the GPS from the backend
  6. The subscription restarts for a fresh 1 year from the new activation date
🧮 Worked Example
If GPS was activated in January on a ₹1999/- plan, and the FO requests the phone-number change in May — that's 5 months of usage.
  • Cost for 5 months used: ₹1999 ÷ 12 = ₹167/month → ₹833/- for 5 months
  • FO pays ₹833/- on the new Boss account
  • We add the difference of ₹2666/- (₹1500 device cost + remaining 7 months' subscription) to complete the new order
Once the GPS is activated, inform the FO and close the ticket after taking his consent.

🔒 Relay Not Working (Immobilizer)

🚨 Unable to unlock the ignition after locking it from the app — ACT IMMEDIATELY on this. This is a safety-critical, highest-priority scenario.
🆘 If the vehicle is locked and won't unlock — act now
  1. Immediately send a highest priority email to the tech support team to check if HQ can act on this directly
  2. The team leader/manager ensures closure on top priority
  3. Ask the FO for the truck's current location
  4. If tech support can't resolve it, immediately call the respective ZOM/IM/LT of that state
Highest-priority escalation email:
✉️ Send Urgent Immobilizer Email (+ your team lead/manager)
🔧 Relay Simply "Not Working" (Not a Lock-Out)
🔍 Check First

Check internally whether the relay was installed in the truck. If you can't check internally, politely ask the FO if he's aware whether it was installed.

Relay Was NOT Installed
Relay WAS Installed

❌ Relay Not Installed

Inform the FO: "Sir, the ignition on/off feature only works if the relay is installed."

FO wants it installed

Ask for the location and date the truck will be available so a technician can be arranged. Assign the ticket to the respective IM/LT.

ZOM/IM/LT closes the ticket once the relay is installed and activated, after the FO's consent.

FO doesn't want it installed

Close the ticket after taking the FO's consent.

✅ Relay Was Installed

🔍 Check First

Check with the FO if he's aware how our immobilizer feature works:

  • The engine does NOT automatically turn off if the vehicle's ignition is on, no matter the speed
  • Instead, it gets locked once the engine is manually turned off from the keys — meaning it won't restart unless unlocked from the app

If the FO understands this — ask for the truck's location and availability date so a technician can be arranged, and assign the ticket to the respective IM/LT. ZOM/IM/LT closes the ticket once the relay is checked and working, after the FO's consent.

🔍 How to Find Loads

🔍 Check First

Check if the customer's KYC is completed or not.

❌ KYC Not Completed
🗣️ Say to Customer

Dear Customer, we would request you to please complete your KYC so that you can avail double loads / more loads.

Dear Customer, hum request karenge ki aap apni KYC complete kar lein taaki aapko double loads / zyada loads mil sakein.
✅ KYC Completed

Ask the customer to open the BlackBuck App and guide them through the steps below.

Steps to Find Loads
  1. Ask the customer to open the BlackBuck app
  2. Click on "Find Loads"
  3. Enter "From (Anywhere)" and "To (Anywhere)" locations
  4. Ask the customer for his truck type, and select Truck Type
  5. Ask the customer for his truck's passing ton, and select Tonnage
  6. Click on "Find Loads"
  7. All available loads will be visible
  8. Click on the "Call Now" option for the customer's selected load — a green tick mark next to the transporter's name means the customer is a verified transporter
  9. If the load of the customer's choice isn't visible, ask him to click "Set Alert" (blue bell icon, top-right corner)
